searchText: Was there ever a "proper EIP" proposed corresponding to the EVM memory bound changes that I proposed? https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/proposals_to_adjust_memory_gas_costs I don't think so. Would there be enthusiasm if I write it? Getting it into prague would be tricky. Stapling it onto EOF would make EOF harder to ship. Given we have removing gas introspection as a feature of EOF we can transparently change the gas costing of memory without wedging contracts. It's legacy I'm concerned about tweaking gas schedules in. I think we need to see the impact on older contracts, so we know what we break. I think it's a good one for Amsterdam (Next+2, late '25/early '26) or maybe possibly Osaka (Next+1 early-mid '25) but Verkle has explicitly stated the want the whole Osaka fork to themselves.
